definitionZh: :目标CSS伪类选择文档的目标元素. 当文档被加载时,目标元素会使用文档的URL片段标识符生成.
sourceDefinition: The :target CSS pseudo-class selects the target element of the document. When the document is loaded, the target element is derived using the document's URL fragment identifier.
